name: persistent-memory
description: Persistent Memory System for long-running projects: Claude reads durable, archived memory files from your own storage at the start of each session instead of making you re-explain context. Use when the user says 'persistent memory', 'remember my project', 'log our decisions in files', or complains about re-explaining context. Not for one-off chats.

memory_dir.title: Memory folder
memory_dir.description: Local folder that holds your Persistent_Memory_System files (for example your synced Dropbox folder). Optional: only used by the session-start index hook.
